1.en_consolidated_definition:
There are two classes of palm fronds classified as sweet and salted on plantations. The sweet ones produce a flexible yagua from which very resistant strips are extracted that serve to be used as ropes.

Nota: La "yagua" es un término específico de Puerto Rico que se refiere a una hoja del palmito, pero en este contexto se utiliza para describir la hoja flexible de la palma.
